title: Annex 71 N2 living-room thermal-mapping diagnostic

numerical_tolerances.untouched_holdout_temperature_rmse_c: less than or equal to 1.0 degC
numerical_tolerances.untouched_holdout_absolute_temperature_b: less than or equal to 0.5 degC
numerical_tolerances.parameter_bound_margin: at least 1 percent of each declared bounded interval

known_deviations: The arbitrary 60/40 split crosses substantial solar and operated-opening regime changes and does not follow the official blind/open workflow.
Only the N2 living-room series and selected measured forcings are mapped to a one-node helper; neither production adapter is exercised.
The full multizone topology, mass nodes, interzone exchange, and operated openings are not mapped.
Channel-level measurement uncertainty was not established, so uncertainty-weighted residual coverage is not claimed.
The holdout RMSE and bias fail the frozen criteria and capacity and conductance land on bounds; this is a rejected alternative.
